description: Plan v7 section 8.3 runtime-limits clause: maximumExpressionTokens pinned exactly at 9, the infix token count of both expressions in this catalog — GROUP_START, a, >, 0, GROUP_END, &&, b, ==, 1 and its fragment twin. ExpressionEvaluator.validateInfixTokens counts the INFIX list at the head of convertTokensToReversePolishNotation, before shunting-yard conversion, and whitespace produces no token, so an implementation that counted RPN tokens (7, parentheses dropped), counted whitespace, or dropped the parentheses would measure something other than 9 and fail to construct this fixture. Probe-verified: at limit 8 the library reports 'Expression contains 9 tokens'. Same catalog as the characters and nesting fixtures so only the limit under test differs.
